welcome.title: Welcome to PARZI
welcome.subtitle: One question to take you to the right place. You can change it later.

aspirant.desc: Train with PARZI Academy: lessons, quizzes, progression and ranks. Prepare for the exam and build your reputation.

agent.desc: Access Parzi Manage: your pro cockpit — players, mandates, clubs, market watch, AI copilot. The tool for established agents.

welcome.footer: One PARZI account links both — your progress follows you everywhere.

verify.title: Agent verification
verify.subtitle: Get your FFF/FIFA licence verified to unlock contact features and display your “verified agent” badge.

verified.title: Your licence is verified
verified.body: Your account shows the “verified agent” badge and you have access to all contact features: CRM, club network and outreach.

pending.title: Verification in progress
pending.body: We're checking your licence number. Access to contact features opens as soon as it's approved — usually within 48h during the beta.

rejected.title: Your request wasn't approved
rejected.body: The number provided couldn't be confirmed. Check it and resubmit your request.

why.title: Why this step?
why.body: Under French law, only a licensed agent may connect a player and a club. Verification protects the ecosystem and gives players and clubs a mark of trust in you.

form.name: Full name
form.number_hint: Your licence number is on the public agents register — it is not secret data.

gate.title: {feature} — verified agents only
gate.body: This feature is used to contact players and clubs. It's reserved for agents whose licence is verified. Get your licence verified — it's quick.
gate.body_pending: Your verification is in progress. As soon as it's approved, this feature unlocks automatically.
gate.legal: Under French law, paid introductions are the domain of the licensed agent. This step protects everyone.

verif.title: Agent verifications
verif.subtitle: Approve or reject licence verification requests.
verif.note_beta: During the beta, approval is manual. It will later be automated against the public FFF/FIFA register.
